text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Did Machitan swap out her engine or 
something?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I didn't even load it in the first 
place!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Because she zoomed forward with an insane 
burst! She's definitely up to something!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, even if you say that, I'm just acting 
normal like always...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Because I just eat normally, sleep 
normally, train normally—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is the stuff Trainer's 
teaching me, like how to use my legs and 
the right race mindset.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. Even if I'm ordinary, my 
Trainer is no ordinary person...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Which means Machitan's Trainer is 
Machitan's engine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it feels just like a three-legged 
race, which is pretty great!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, Machikane Tannhauser thanked me 
over and over again!"
